proof_body:
by
  intro m n
  have e : ∀ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (Complex.I * m * x) * Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * n * x)) = Complex.exp ((((m - n : ℤ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * x) := by
    intro x
    rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  simp_rw [e]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    simp
  · have hc : ((m - n : ℤ) : ℂ) * Complex.I ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast sub_ne_zero.2 h) Complex.I_ne_zero
    rw [integral_exp_mul_complex hc]
    have h2 : Complex.exp ((((m - n : ℤ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ)) = 1 := by
      calc Complex.exp ((((m - n : ℤ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * ((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ))
          = Complex.exp (((m - n : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)) := by
            congr 1
            push_cast
            ring
        _ = 1 := Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I _
    rw [h2]
    simp
target_source: ∀ (m n : ℤ), (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), Complex.exp (Complex.I * m * x) * Complex.exp (-(Complex.I * n * x))) = if m = n then (2 * Real.pi : ℂ) else 0
